title: Project-Wide Edits
description: Work across files: follow paths, find files anywhere, and change every file at once with the quickfix list.

intro: Neovim works across a project without plugins. gf follows a file name in the text, :find opens a file by name from anywhere in 'path', and :vimgrep searches every file for a pattern.

Search results go into the quickfix list, a list of positions in files. :copen shows it, ]q and [q move through it, and :cdo runs a command at every entry, which makes a rename across a project one line.

commands.text: Open the file whose name is under the cursor. <C-o> brings you back.
:vim /pattern/ ** searches every file under the current directory and puts each match in the quickfix list.
Run a command at each quickfix entry, such as :cdo s/old/new/.
Open a file by name, searching the directories in 'path'. With ** in 'path' that's the whole tree, and Tab completes the name.

levels.title: Follow the path
levels.description: greet.lua has a typo. Open it straight from the dofile() call and fix 'helo'.
levels.hint: gf opens the file whose name is under the cursor. Saving isn't required.

levels.title: Rename everywhere
levels.description: getUser is now fetchUser. Rename it in every file without opening them one by one.
levels.hint: :vimgrep /pattern/ ** fills the quickfix list with every match in the project; :cdo runs a command on each entry.

levels.title: Deep find
levels.description: Turn debug on. The settings file is buried somewhere under src/, and you don't need to know where.
levels.hint: :find searches 'path', which here includes ** (as after set path+=**) for a file name, and Tab completes it. :fin is enough.
